plan for agent boss
  user digi-boss, profile coordinator, model sonnet, sandbox coordinator-v1
  capabilities agent.nudge, board.coordinate, board.read, data.read, host.read, monitor.read, net.egress, usage.read, worker.request
  capability install steps data.read:executor-user, host.read:executor-user, data.read:setup, host.read:setup, agent.nudge:wrappers, board.coordinate:wrappers, board.read:wrappers, data.read:wrappers, host.read:wrappers, monitor.read:wrappers, usage.read:wrappers, worker.request:wrappers, board.read:read-grants, agent.nudge:channels, board.coordinate:channels, board.read:channels, data.read:channels, host.read:channels, monitor.read:channels, worker.request:channels
actions, in order: the board grant is deferred (step 40); every ACL and channel grant follows policy publication:
  1. package bubblewrap: apt-get install; bwrap is missing
  2. package socat: apt-get install; socat is missing
  3. service-user digi-data: create: system user, no login shell, home /home/digi-data 0700
  4. service-user digi-observe: create: system user, no login shell, home /home/digi-observe 0700
  5. user digi-boss: common/install/add_user.sh digi-boss --prepare: useradd --create-home --user-group --shell /bin/bash; /home/digi-boss and /home/digi 0750
  6. group digipaddock-cabinet: digi-boss joins it through common/install/cabinet_setup.sh grant: the board's socket (KD-225)
  7. download /home/digi-boss/.local/bin/claude: Claude Code, the base user's version, from https://claude.ai/install.sh (network)
  8. dir /home/digi-boss/.config: digi-boss:digi-boss 0700, made by digi-boss
  9. plugin hindsight: if /etc/hindsight/coding-agent.env exists: @vectorize-io/hindsight-coding-agents through npx for digi-boss (network)
 10. file /home/digi-boss/.hindsight/coding-agent.json: digi-boss:digi-boss 0600, made by digi-boss if Hindsight runs: holds the API key (value not shown)

--- /etc/apparmor.d/bwrap (root:root 0644)

  userns,

owner steps after the install:
  - if the host has no Claude token yet: claude setup-token, then kd-secret put claude-token (once for all agents; a login of digi-boss also works); the session host starts boss after session_host_setup.sh enable boss
